# Paracord

> A TypeScript/Node.js toolkit for building scalable Discord bots with REST, Gateway, and optional gRPC-based remote services for rate limits and requests.

## Primary Exports

```
import Paracord from 'paracord';
import { Paracord, Api, Gateway, ShardLauncher, Server } from 'paracord';
```

- `Paracord` — Multi-shard gateway orchestrator (default export). Extends `EventEmitter`.
- `Api` — REST client with built-in rate limit handling.
- `Gateway` — Single Discord WebSocket session manager.
- `ShardLauncher` — pm2-based process spawner for shards.
- `Server` — gRPC server for centralized rate limits and remote REST requests.

## Quick Start

### Basic Bot (Paracord)

```js
const { Paracord } = require('paracord');

// Discord dispatch events are not emitted on the bot instance. They reach you through
// `handleEvent`: subclass Paracord and override it, calling super to keep Paracord's
// own startup bookkeeping.
class Bot extends Paracord {
  handleEvent(type, data, shard) {
    super.handleEvent(type, data, shard);
    if (type === 'GUILD_CREATE') { /* handle */ }
  }
}

const bot = new Bot(token, {
  gatewayOptions: { wsUrl, wsParams }
});
bot.on('PARACORD_STARTUP_COMPLETE', () => { /* all shards ready */ });
await bot.login({
  identity: { intents: 32767 },
  shards: [0, 1],
  shardCount: 2,
});
```

### REST Requests (Api)

```js
const { Api } = require('paracord');
const api = new Api(token);
const res = await api.request('GET', '/channels/123456789');
// res: { status, statusText, data, headers }
```

### RPC Setup

```js
const { Server } = require('paracord');
const server = new Server({ host: '127.0.0.1', port: '50051' });
server.addRateLimitService();
server.addRequestService(token);
server.serve();

// Client side:
await api.addRateLimitService({ host: '127.0.0.1', port: '50051', allowFallback: true });
```

### Shard Launcher (pm2)

```js
const { ShardLauncher } = require('paracord');
const launcher = new ShardLauncher('./bot.js', {
  token,
  shardIds: [0, 1, 2],
  shardCount: 3,
});
await launcher.launch();
```

## Key Signatures

```
Api(token: string, options?: ApiOptions)
Api.request<T>(method: Method, url: string, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<ApiResponse<T>>
Api.addRateLimitService(options?: ServiceOptions): Promise<boolean>
Api.addRequestService(options?: ServiceOptions): Promise<boolean>
Api.end(): void

Gateway(token: string, options: GatewayOptions)
Gateway.login(): void
Gateway.close(code?: GatewayCloseCode, flushWait?: number): void
Gateway.requestGuildMembers(options: GatewayRequestGuildMembersData): boolean
Gateway.beginSessionHandoff(): SessionHandoffState   // pins heartbeats at the session's sequence and returns it
Gateway.importSession(state: SessionHandoffState): void   // validate-first; the next login() RESUMEs it
Gateway.clearHeartbeatPin(): void
Gateway.heartbeatPinned: boolean   // login() throws and no close reconnects while true

// Session (internal, Gateway's own delegate — not exported from dist/index.d.ts, the
// package's own `types` entry point; listed only so its changed close() signature is on
// record). Not a supported entry point — use Gateway.close() above.
Session.close(code: GatewayCloseCode, flushWaitTime: number, origin: CloseOrigin): void

Paracord(token: string, options: ParacordOptions)  extends EventEmitter
Paracord.login(options?: Partial<ParacordLoginOptions>): Promise<void>
Paracord.end(): void

ShardLauncher(main: string, options: ShardLauncherOptions)
ShardLauncher.launch(pm2Options?: StartOptions): Promise<void>

Server(options?: RpcServerOptions)  extends grpc.Server
Server.addRateLimitService(): void
Server.addRequestService(token: string, apiOptions?: ApiOptions): void
Server.serve(): void
```

## Events

Events the Paracord instance emits (`bot.on(name, handler)`):

- Gateway lifecycle: `GATEWAY_OPEN`, `GATEWAY_CLOSE`, `GATEWAY_IDENTIFY`
- Startup: `SHARD_STARTUP_COMPLETE`, `PARACORD_STARTUP_COMPLETE`
- Debug: `DEBUG`

Everything else reaches a consumer through `handleEvent(type, data, shard)`, never through `bot.on`.
As types: every `GatewayEvent` — all `GatewayDispatchEvents` (`READY`, `GUILD_CREATE`,
`MESSAGE_CREATE`, …) plus `HELLO` and `INVALID_SESSION` — and every `ParacordGatewayEvent` the
instance does not itself emit: `GATEWAY_RESUME`, `HEARTBEAT_SENT`, `HEARTBEAT_ACK`,
`GUILD_MEMBERS_CHUNK`, `REQUEST_GUILD_MEMBERS`. Each `Gateway` passes them to its emitter's
`handleEvent`; for a `Paracord` bot that is `Paracord#handleEvent` (startup bookkeeping only) —
subclass and override it, as in the quick start. A bare `Gateway` receives them on the `emitter`
object's own `handleEvent`.

## Key Types

- `discord-api-types/v10` — All Discord payload types come from this package.
- `ApiOptions` — `{ emitter?, requestOptions?, maxConcurrency? }`
- `RequestOptions` — `{ data?, headers?, params?, local?, returnOnRateLimit?, globalRateLimitMax?, version?, timeout? }`
- `GatewayOptions` — `{ identity, emitter, wsUrl, wsParams, heartbeatIntervalOffset?, version? }`
- `SessionHandoffState` — `{ sessionId, sequence, shard, resumeUrl? }`. Credential-adjacent: never log it.
- `IdentityOptions` — `{ intents, shard?, compress?, largeThreshold?, presence? }`
- `ParacordOptions` — `{ gatewayOptions, unavailableGuildTolerance?, unavailableGuildWait?, shardStartupTimeout?, compressShards? }`
- `ParacordLoginOptions` — `{ identity, shards?, shardCount?, allowConnection? }`
- `ShardLauncherOptions` — `{ token?, shardIds?, shardChunks?, shardCount?, appName?, env? }`
- `ServiceOptions` — `{ host?, port?, channel?, allowFallback? }`
- `RpcServerOptions` — `{ host?, port?, channel?, emitter?, apiClient?, globalRateLimitMax?, globalRateLimitResetPadding? }`
- `ApiResponse<T>` — `{ status, statusText, data: T, headers, retry_after? }`

## Defaults

- Discord API version: `10`
- Global rate limit: `50` requests per second
- Global rate limit reset padding: `50ms`
- RPC host: `127.0.0.1`, port: `50051`
- Tokens are auto-prefixed with `Bot ` if missing.
- `allowFallback` on RPC services: falls back to local handling when the RPC server is unreachable or a call exceeds its 10 s deadline.
- REST retry: a 5xx or transport error is retried up to 3 attempts for GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PUT and DELETE; 1 attempt for every other method (POST and PATCH are never retried).
- RPC: every call carries a 10 s deadline. After a transport failure with `allowFallback`, a request is re-sent locally only for GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PUT and DELETE; a POST or PATCH is never re-sent by the client.
- Proxied responses: `data` is parsed once, the same value a local request yields.
- Request `timeout` (ms; client-wide in `requestOptions` or per request, per-request overrides): applies to each attempt as an inactivity bound, not a wall-clock one; `0` or absent is none; a timed-out GET/HEAD/OPTIONS/PUT/DELETE is retried (3 attempts), POST/PATCH fail on the first; not carried over the RPC request proxy.
- RPC request proxy: a form upload (a `form-data` `FormData` from `createForm` or `data`) is rejected before anything is sent; pass `local: true` or use a client with no request service.
- `Api.end()`: cancels the RPC reconnect, rejects queued requests, cancels in-flight RPC calls and closes the RPC connection; any later request rejects with a "client has ended" error and nothing is sent.
- Gateway reconnect: backoff 1 s base, doubling, ±20% jitter, 60 s cap, never gives up; after 3 consecutive 1006 failures the resume host is abandoned and the session RESUMEs on the base URL, session kept.
- Heartbeat: while a members request is in flight, up to 3 unacknowledged heartbeats are tolerated; `HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT` fires on the 4th (no `heartbeatTimeoutSeconds` default).

## Utilities

```
coerceTokenToBotLike(token: string): string
timestampFromSnowflake(snowflake: Snowflake): number
computeChannelPerms({ member, guild, channel }): bigint
computeGuildPerms({ member, guild }): bigint
constructUserAvatarUrl(user, options?): string
constructGuildIcon(guild, fileType?): string | undefined   // guild: { id, icon_hash? | icon? }; icon_hash wins
clone<T>(object: T): T
isApiError(val: unknown): val is ApiError
```
